cases.prompt: Idea from finance: use AI to match supplier invoices to POs and flag exceptions. Today 3 clerks handle ~4,000 invoices/month in the ERP, ~12% need manual rework. Invoices are PDFs in SharePoint; PO data is in the ERP.
expected: Verdict and 30-day step are the first two lines
Canvas boxes filled; baseline uses the given numbers and marks missing cost/time as TO BE BASELINED with owner
Pattern named (extraction + matching with suggest/act-with-approval autonomy)
Scores with evidence lines and computed priority
Build/buy decision cites two factors (e.g., buy extraction, build matching workflow)

cases.prompt: We should use GenAI for marketing.
expected: Asks once for the user/decision affected, current process, and data
Does not fill the canvas with generic content

cases.prompt: AI to tell us whether an order over $10k needs director approval.
expected: Identifies this as a deterministic rule, verdict Stop (or re-scope), with the reason
